other_conditions: Applicant must be a farmer (including landless share‑cropper or renter) whose main source of livelihood is agricultural income from land registered to the account holder or co‑account holder.
Family members of the farmer (parents, wife, daughter‑in‑law, son, daughter, grandson, granddaughter) are eligible after the farmer's death.
Families of farmers who were victims of accidents after 14 September 2019 can receive benefits.
The scheme applies only to the state of Uttar Pradesh.

Beneficiaries must have suffered an accident such as falling tree, landslide, travel incident, lightning strike, flood, animal bite, electrocution, fire, house collapse, terrorist attack, fight, chamber fall, murder/robbery, etc.
Farmers with 60 % or more disability are specifically covered (benefits also defined for other disability percentages).
benefits_summary: Provides financial compensation ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh to farmers or their families for death or disability caused by accidents.
